---
Test
---
!define TEST_SYSTEM {slim}
!3 A failing comparison: what the cell shows
This page fails on purpose (it is not part of any suite): it shows how differences are rendered when a '''check … OK''' row fails. The README screenshot docs/images/ui-failure.png is taken from it.

|import|
|io.github.tortaje.compare|

|script|json comparison|
|check|compare file|src/test/resources/e2e/expected/order.json|to|{{{
{
  "id": "O-1",
  "createdAt": "yesterday",
  "status": "CLOSED",
  "total": 42.5,
  "lines": [
    {"sku": "A", "qty": 2},
    {"sku": "B", "qty": 3}
  ],
  "note": "x"
}
}}}|OK|

|script|xml comparison|
|check|compare file|src/test/resources/e2e/expected/order.xml|to|{{{
<order id="O-9" created="2026-12-31">
  <status>CLOSED</status>
  <total>42.5</total>
  <lines>
    <line sku="A" qty="2"/>
  </lines>
</order>
}}}|OK|
